notes: Page states these are Fedders-Airwell serial styles being used for Koppel, adding 'although unconfirmed it is believed that all Fedders-Airwell units use these styles' — that unconfirmed-belief caveat is recorded here and flagged for the coordinator (cf. the Emerson unconfirmed-belief precedent: text-stated rules ship with the caveat on file, not silently). NOTHING is imported from any Fedders page: the shipped style is transcribed from Koppel's own page text alone. CORRECTION (post-Wave-8, coordinator): page Style 1 (week = 3rd-4th characters, year = 5th-6th characters, example EW020144126H) was shipped in Wave 8 and has been REMOVED — it shares its shape (2 letters + 9 digits + 1 letter) with held page Style 3 (AS298488006X, month = 1st character and year = 2nd characters, both chart-only), so a Style 3 serial would mis-decode under Style 1 with a wrong week/year. Same hold as the Emerson, Melcor, and Airwell files; the collision was caught from the Melcor curator's Wave 9 flag. HELD, NOT SHIPPED: page Style 1 (shape collision, see above), page Style 3 (month = 1st letter, year = 2nd characters, both chart), page Style 4 (month = 1st letter, year = 2nd characters, both chart), page Style 5 (month = 2nd-to-last letter, year = last letter, both chart) — no text-verified year, so no year-only file for them. Style 2 ships year-only (its month is a chart-only letter).

styles.era: 8-character serials, 2 digits + letter + 5 digits, year only
styles.notes: Page example shown as 02J-60002; dash stripped by normalization. Year = 1st-2nd characters [0,2]. Month = 3rd character (letter), chart-only, so year-only.
